english_title: Recognising and Responding to Choosing a Simple Food
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: food & drink — choosing a simple food
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to choosing a simple food; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Olivia offers Ms Lan a choice between rice and noodles.
context_note_vi: Chị Olivia mời chị Lan chọn giữa cơm và mì.

turns.speaker: Ms Olivia
turns.english: Lan, would you like rice or noodles?
turns.vietnamese: Lan này, chị muốn cơm hay mì?

turns.speaker: Ms Olivia
turns.english: Rice. I will bring it now.
turns.vietnamese: Cơm nhé. Để tôi mang ra ngay.
